sourcePolicy: Relative paths refer to the same pinned revision as this digest-covered export. Historical references and private runs are not published ports.

targetVersions: ChatGPT desktop app with Settings > Appearance import (2026-09)

verification.reason: No recorded real-import protocol bound to this subject.

appearance-settings.reason: Mode, accent, background, foreground, contrast, UI and code font size, reduce motion, separate light and dark, diff markers, and the diff and skill colours in the import string.

text-ladder.reason: One global foreground: prose, muted, subtle and disabled text follow ChatGPT's own derivation.

surfaces.reason: One background; ChatGPT derives its other surfaces.

interaction.reason: Focus and state colours follow the accent.

status-colours.reason: Only diff added, diff removed and skill have colours.

code-colours.reason: Syntax colours come from the code theme ChatGPT offers.

typography.reason: Only two sizes; fonts stay the system default.

geometry.reason: ChatGPT keeps its own rounded corners and focus ring; j3w1's zero radius and dashed focus ring cannot be set.

files.install: Open ChatGPT > Settings > Appearance > Dark theme > Import and paste a preset's import string, or set the values in the preset's table by hand (see ports/chatgpt/README.md).

ports.rollback: In ChatGPT: Settings > Appearance, import the theme copied before, or choose another theme and set back each row of the preset table that was changed. Nothing is installed on disk.

theme-roles.reason: Claude Code's custom theme (base dark-ansi) sets these roles: text and accents, message backgrounds, input and dialog borders, status, diff lines, the usage meter and subagent names.

terminal-palette.reason: Claude Code runs in a terminal and uses its sixteen slots, background and cursor; the terminal's own theme sets them.

fixed-ansi.reason: Highlighted code, links (slot 12), diff + and - markers and file previews use fixed ANSI slots that no theme reaches.

light-mode.reason: The theme has no light profile; the custom theme is dark (base dark-ansi) in every mode.

outside-claude.reason: Roles Claude Code's theme has no key for: primitives, interface colours of other components and every value that is not a colour.

files.install: Save as ~/.claude/themes/j3w1.json and set "theme": "custom:j3w1" in ~/.claude/settings.json; or run node ports/claude-code/install.mjs apply in a clone of this repository (see its README).

ports.rollback: Run node ports/claude-code/install.mjs restore in the same clone. By hand: set "theme" in ~/.claude/settings.json back to your previous theme (or remove the key) and delete ~/.claude/themes/j3w1.json.

fixed-ansi.reason: Status, diff signs, the brand and the status line use ANSI slots 1-6 that Codex names; the prompt and composer fills are computed from the terminal background.

terminal-palette.reason: Codex runs in a terminal and uses its sixteen slots and background; the terminal's own theme sets them.

outside-codex.reason: Roles a tmTheme has no key for: primitives, interface colours and every value that is not a colour.
